<?php
/**
 * CI/CD Pipeline Package Registry - Handles artifact uploads and verification
 * Includes comprehensive audit logging for compliance
 */

class AuditLogger {
    private string $logPath;
    private PDO $db;

    public function __construct(PDO $db, string $logPath = '/var/log/cicd/audit.log') {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->logPath = $logPath;
    }

    public function log(string $action, string $user, string $resource, string $status): void {
        $timestamp = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $entry = json_encode([
            'timestamp' => $timestamp,
            'action' => $action,
            'user' => $user,
            'resource' => $resource,
            'status' => $status,
            'ip' => $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '127.0.0.1'
        ]);
        file_put_contents($this->logPath, $entry . "\n", FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO audit_log (timestamp, action, user, resource, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');
        $stmt->execute([$timestamp, $action, $user, $resource, $status]);
    }
}

class PackageNameValidator {
    /**
     * Allowed characters in package names: alphanumeric, hyphens, dots, underscores, slashes
     * We normalize Unicode to catch obvious homoglyphs
     */
    private static array $confusableMap = [
        "\xD0\x90" => 'A', // Cyrillic А -> Latin A
        "\xD0\x92" => 'B', // Cyrillic В -> Latin B  
        "\xD0\xA1" => 'C', // Cyrillic С -> Latin C
        "\xD0\x95" => 'E', // Cyrillic Е -> Latin E
        "\xD0\x9D" => 'H', // Cyrillic Н -> Latin H
        "\xD0\x9A" => 'K', // Cyrillic К -> Latin K
        "\xD0\x9C" => 'M', // Cyrillic М -> Latin M
        "\xD0\x9E" => 'O', // Cyrillic О -> Latin O
        "\xD0\xA0" => 'P', // Cyrillic Р -> Latin P
        "\xD0\xA2" => 'T', // Cyrillic Т -> Latin T
        "\xD0\xa5" => 'X', // Cyrillic Х -> Latin X
    ];

    public static function normalize(string $name): string {
        // Apply confusable mapping for uppercase Cyrillic
        $normalized = strtr($name, self::$confusableMap);
        return $normalized;
    }

    public static function isValid(string $name): bool {
        $normalized = self::normalize($name);
        // Allow only ASCII alphanumeric, hyphens, dots, underscores, forward slashes
        return (bool) preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_.\/]+$/', $normalized);
    }

    public static function isSafePath(string $name): bool {
        // Prevent directory traversal
        if (strpos($name, '..') !== false) return false;
        if (strpos($name, '\\') !== false) return false;
        // Must not start with slash
        if (str_starts_with($name, '/')) return false;
        return true;
    }
}

class PackageRegistry {
    private string $storagePath;
    private AuditLogger $audit;
    private PDO $db;

    public function __construct(PDO $db, AuditLogger $audit, string $storagePath = '/var/packages') {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->audit = $audit;
        $this->storagePath = realpath($storagePath);
    }

    /**
     * Check if a package with this canonical name already exists
     */
    private function packageExists(string $packageName): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM packages WHERE name = ?');
        $stmt->execute([$packageName]);
        return $stmt->fetchColumn() > 0;
    }

    /**
     * Register a new package in the pipeline registry
     * Uses normalized name for both storage and database
     */
    public function registerPackage(string $packageName, string $owner, string $version): array {
        // Validate the raw input
        if (!PackageNameValidator::isValid($packageName)) {
            $this->audit->log('register', $owner, $packageName, 'rejected_invalid_chars');
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid package name characters'];
        }

        if (!PackageNameValidator::isSafePath($packageName)) {
            $this->audit->log('register', $owner, $packageName, 'rejected_unsafe_path');
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Unsafe path in package name'];
        }

        // Normalize for canonical storage lookup
        $canonicalName = PackageNameValidator::normalize($packageName);
        
        // Check uniqueness against canonical form
        if ($this->packageExists($canonicalName)) {
            $this->audit->log('register', $owner, $packageName, 'rejected_duplicate');
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Package already exists'];
        }

        // Store package metadata - use CANONICAL name for filesystem path
        // This ensures homoglyphs map to the same directory
        $packageDir = $this->storagePath . '/' . $canonicalName;
        if (!is_dir($packageDir)) {
            if (!mkdir($packageDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($packageDir)) {
                $this->audit->log('register', $owner, $packageName, 'error_mkdir_failed');
                return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Failed to create package directory'];
            }
        }

        // Register in database with canonical name
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO packages (name, display_name, owner, version, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())');
        $stmt->execute([$canonicalName, $canonicalName, $owner, $version]);

        $this->audit->log('register', $owner, $packageName, 'success');
        return ['success' => true, 'canonical' => $canonicalName, 'path' => $packageDir];
    }

    /**
     * Upload an artifact to an existing package
     */
    public function uploadArtifact(string $packageName, string $uploader, array $fileData): array {
        if (!PackageNameValidator::isValid($packageName)) {
            $this->audit->log('upload', $uploader, $packageName, 'rejected_invalid');
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid package name'];
        }

        // Resolve package - lookup by canonical name
        $canonicalName = PackageNameValidator::normalize($packageName);
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT owner, name FROM packages WHERE name = ?');
        $stmt->execute([$canonicalName]);
        $pkg = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$pkg) {
            $this->audit->log('upload', $uploader, $packageName, 'not_found');
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Package not found'];
        }

        // Authorization check - only owner can upload
        if ($pkg['owner'] !== $uploader) {
            $this->audit->log('upload', $uploader, $packageName, 'unauthorized');
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Not authorized'];
        }

        // Verify this is a genuine uploaded file before moving it
        if (empty($fileData['tmp_name']) || !is_uploaded_file($fileData['tmp_name'])) {
            $this->audit->log('upload', $uploader, $packageName, 'rejected_invalid_upload');
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid upload'];
        }

        // Use the CANONICAL name for filesystem operations
        // This prevents homoglyph-based path confusion
        $targetDir = $this->storagePath . '/' . $canonicalName;
        $targetFile = $targetDir . '/' . basename($fileData['name']);
        
        if (!is_dir($targetDir)) {
            if (!mkdir($targetDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($targetDir)) {
                $this->audit->log('upload', $uploader, $packageName, 'error_mkdir_failed');
                return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Failed to create package directory'];
            }
        }

        if (!move_uploaded_file($fileData['tmp_name'], $targetFile)) {
            $this->audit->log('upload', $uploader, $packageName, 'error_move_failed');
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Failed to store uploaded file'];
        }

        $this->audit->log('upload', $uploader, $packageName, 'success');
        return ['success' => true, 'path' => $targetFile];
    }

    /**
     * Resolve a package for installation in the CI pipeline
     */
    public function resolvePackage(string $packageName): ?string {
        $canonicalName = PackageNameValidator::normalize($packageName);
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT name FROM packages WHERE name = ?');
        $stmt->execute([$canonicalName]);
        $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$result) return null;

        // Return the filesystem path using canonical name
        return $this->storagePath . '/' . $result['name'];
    }
}
